name: Daniel Bilezikian
abstract_title: Wave mechanics of ciliary proteins: Quantum-enabled sensing in the ‘cellular antenna’ and dark states in the centriole
abstract: Cilia and their nucleating bodies, centrioles, are enigmatic structures in cell biology. The immotile primary cilium, lacking motor proteins required to drive fluid flow, was widely considered vestigial throughout the 20th century, in sharp contrast to the modern view of primary cilia as central to sensation, cellular differentiation, and development. This revolution has been guided by advances in molecular biology, nanoscale imaging, and the strict conservation of the cilium-centriole apparatus
authors: Daniel Bilezikian, Dylan Davidoff, Paul Weiss
notes: Cornell '23 alumnus. No peer-reviewed publications found.
